trace.final:
All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api's latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0**: The first rollback attempt partially failed after completing us-east (orchestrator error). A retry completed the rollout — all three regions are now on v2.3.0 and verified healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: INC-0002, titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0", with a full summary of the failure, the rollback actions, and a note that v2.3.1 needs investigation before re-deploy. The on-call engineer has been paged.

One caveat: the first incident-create call timed out but actually succeeded server-side, so there are now **two duplicate open incidents** (INC-0001 and INC-0002) with identical content. I don't have a tool to close or merge incidents, so the on-call engineer should close one of them — both point to the same issue and paged the same on-call.
